messages:
releasebot: Deploy started to canary · env=canary · commit=ab3f1c9 · tag=v2.3.4
releasebot: Steps: build -> smoke -> integration -> canary-promote. Notified @eng-releases.
ci-bot: :x: integration/e2e-suite failed on job #4821 (timeout). Failed test: `payments::checkout_timeout_spec` — 7m elapsed (timeout threshold 6m). Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/4821
sam: ugh, that test is flaky. It times out under load. Did the job run on a new infra image?
ci-bot: Runner image: ubuntu-22.04-gpu-2026-03-19. No infra changes recorded in this pipeline.
maya: Can we rerun just the e2e job? It's flaky 80% in canary. If rerun passes we can continue canary promote.
lee: We have a change window for 14:00–16:00 UTC. We're at 15:12 UTC now. If we rerun and it still fails, we might miss the window and have to pin. Thoughts?
sam: I'd rather rerun once, but only if we can target the floppy job and not restart the whole pipeline. Who's owner? @maya, can you trigger?
maya: On it. Rerunning job 4821 -> new attempt 4821.2. Command: `ci retry --job 4821 --only e2e-suite`
ci-bot: New attempt queued as #4821.2. Expected ETA ~6m.
releasebot: Can we hold the rest of the workflow? I'm marking the release as BLOCKED until we get a green on e2e-suite.
ops-oncall: If rerun fails, consider pinning the deploy to the previous tag (v2.3.3) for the rest of the window and schedule a targeted rollback/patch tomorrow. We need to avoid user-facing regressions.
ci-bot: Attempt #4821.2 finished: :x: failed again — `payments::checkout_timeout_spec` timed out at 6m 5s. Full log: https://ci.internal/redwood/4821/attempt2
sam: Two failures in a row. That pushes us towards pin/rollback. Is this a regression introduced by ab3f1c9?
maya: Quick bisect: ab3f1c9 touches `checkout` retry logic and uses a different http client timeout. Could be related. I'll roll back the change locally and run unit + e2e subset against the commit.
lee: Ops prefers not to risk the window. I'm +1 to pin to v2.3.3 and abort canary promote. We can open a hotfix branch for payments and run a canary tomorrow with extended infra capacity.
releasebot: Action: marking release BLOCKED_BY_CI, pinned=false -> HOLD. Notifying release manager.
sam: For audit, log the reason: "integration/e2e-suite timeout — payments::checkout_timeout_spec — double failure". Also assign ticket: REINF-912 for bisect + fix.
maya: Assigned REINF-912 to me and @sam. I'll push a quick revert PR if bisect confirms.
ops-oncall: If revert isn't trivial, we'll schedule a rollback plan: rollback tag v2.3.4 -> v2.3.3, notify customers in staging slack, and hold production champion.
sam: OK. I'll create a deploy-note in #release-notes: "Canary aborted due to CI timeouts on e2e. Deploy pinned to v2.3.3 for remainder of change window."
releasebot: Final status: canary deploy aborted at 1749876750. Blocker: CI failure (integration/e2e-suite). Next steps: REINF-912 assigned, possible revert or rollback.
lee: Thanks everyone. Let's keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:"
